title: RX-78 GP02A PHYSALIS GUNDAM
summary: There are very few cons that I can list about this model kit. Its quality is solid and the design is exceeding my wildest dream about a GP kit from Mobile Suit Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory. I love the kits in that series but most of Bandai's MGs are really old and one of them is RE/100 which is not bad but it's not my type.
notes: Decal design. Its decals are really a miss. Terrible size with blurry text. No logo except 01, 02, or 03 numbers. They are too small comparing to what they have in the manual. REALLY!
The batteries are difficult to remove one installed. I had to disassemble the bazooka everytime I want to replace it.
Some of the steps in the manual are either missing or mistake. But only a few of them. This is rather a slight inconvenience.
Joints and movements: you want it, you have it
Color scheme: matching the original design
Plastic quality: better than you can ask from a third party
